panels.title: Telemetry rows (hot)
panels.description: Approximate live row count from pg_stat_user_tables.n_live_tup — cheap and bounded, unlike COUNT(*) on the hypertable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(n_live_tup, 0)::bigint AS rows FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE relname = 'telemetry'

panels.title: Hot tier size
panels.description: TimescaleDB hypertable_size('telemetry') — sum of all chunk relations and indexes, including compressed segments.

panels.title: Chunks (total)
panels.description: Number of Timescale chunks for the telemetry hypertable. Default chunk interval is 1h, so this roughly tracks hot-tier retention.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS chunks FROM timescaledb_information.chunks WHERE hypertable_name = 'telemetry'

panels.title: Hot retention (oldest row age)
panels.description: Age of the oldest row currently in the hot tier. The parquet_export → drop_exported_chunks pipeline trims this back to the export horizon (PARQUET_EXPORT_AGE_HOURS, default 24h) once chunks are safely in MinIO.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MIN(time))), 0)::float AS age_s FROM telemetry

panels.title: Cold tier files
panels.description: Hours fully exported to MinIO per the parquet_exports ledger. One file per closed hour.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS files FROM parquet_exports

panels.title: Cold tier rows
panels.description: Sum of row_count across the parquet_exports ledger — i.e. total telemetry rows currently archived to MinIO.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(row_count), 0)::bigint AS rows FROM parquet_exports

panels.title: Cold tier size
panels.description: Sum of byte_count across the parquet_exports ledger — Parquet's columnar + dictionary + Snappy compression typically gives ~10× reduction vs the hot tier.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(byte_count), 0)::bigint AS bytes FROM parquet_exports

panels.title: Last export age
panels.description: Wall-time since the most recent parquet_export run successfully recorded an hour. The export period is PARQUET_EXPORT_PERIOD_S (default 1h); thresholds are 2× and 4× that. Note: an empty bench will show null indefinitely — that's expected, not stalled.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MAX(exported_at)))::float AS age_s FROM parquet_exports

panels.title: Postgres DB size
panels.description: pg_database_size('lab') — total on-disk size of the metadata database (experiments, schedules, alerts, cycle_features, experiment_steps, plus indexes and WAL).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(n_live_tup, 0)::bigint AS rows FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE relname = 'experiments'
SELECT COALESCE(n_live_tup, 0)::bigint AS rows FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE relname = 'experiment_steps'
SELECT COALESCE(n_live_tup, 0)::bigint AS rows FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE relname = 'cycle_features'

panels.title: Ingest rate (rows/sec, 15-second buckets)
panels.description: COUNT(*) per 15-second time_bucket on the telemetry hypertable, divided by 15. Healthy 512-channel bench at 10 Hz floors around 5,120 rows/s (asserted in `make bench`); dips below that mean lost telemetry, ingester back-pressure, or a chassis dropping out. The in-progress current bucket is excluded — it would otherwise always read low, since the bucket only contains the seconds elapsed so far. Expect the same low reading at the *left* edge if the dashboard time range starts mid-bucket.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('15s', time) AS time, COUNT(*)::float / 15.0 AS rows_per_sec FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND time_bucket('15s', time) < time_bucket('15s', now()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Chunk inventory (newest first)
panels.description: One row per Timescale chunk on the telemetry hypertable. is_compressed=true means the chunk is read-only — modifying it requires decompress → update → recompress (CLAUDE.md gotcha). Once a chunk's covered hours are all in parquet_exports, it's eligible for the export-driven drop policy.

targets.rawSql: SELECT chunk_name, range_start, range_end, is_compressed, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(format('%I.%I', chunk_schema, chunk_name)::regclass)) AS size FROM timescaledb_information.chunks WHERE hypertable_name = 'telemetry' ORDER BY range_start DESC

panels.title: Cold tier files (most recent 50)
panels.description: parquet_exports ledger entries, newest exports first. One row per closed hour landed in MinIO. The s3_path is what duckdb_init.sql globs to build telemetry_cold.

targets.rawSql: SELECT hour_start, exported_at, row_count, pg_size_pretty(byte_count::bigint) AS size, s3_path FROM parquet_exports ORDER BY exported_at DESC LIMIT 50
